"use client"

import { useMemo, useState, type ReactNode } from "react"
import {
  flexRender,
  getCoreRowModel,
  getFilteredRowModel,
  getPaginationRowModel,
  getSortedRowModel,
  useReactTable,
  type ColumnDef,
  type ColumnFiltersState,
  type PaginationState,
  type SortingState,
} from "@tanstack/react-table"
import { Alert, AlertDescription, AlertTitle } from "@/components/ui/alert"
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge"
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button"
import { Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardFooter, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card"
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input"
import { Select, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectTrigger, SelectValue } from "@/components/ui/select"
import { Skeleton } from "@/components/ui/skeleton"
import { Table, TableBody, TableCell, TableHead, TableHeader, TableRow } from "@/components/ui/table"
import { ArrowDown, ArrowUp, ArrowUpDown, Database, Search } from "lucide-react"

export interface AdminTableFilterDefinition {
  name: string
  type: "text" | "number" | "boolean" | "date" | "select"
  options?: readonly (string | number | boolean)[]
}

export interface AdminColumnDefinition {
  key: string
  label: string
  sortable?: boolean
  filterable?: boolean
  filter?: AdminTableFilterDefinition
  render?: (value: unknown, row: Record<string, unknown>) => ReactNode
}

export interface AdminDataTableState {
  pagination: PaginationState
  sorting: SortingState
  columnFilters: ColumnFiltersState
  globalFilter: string
}

const dateFormatter = new Intl.DateTimeFormat(undefined, {
  dateStyle: "medium",
  timeStyle: "short",
})

const humanizeCellValue = (value: string): string =>
  value.replace(/[-_]+/g, " ").replace(/\b\w/g, (letter) => letter.toUpperCase())

function formatAdminCell(value: unknown, key: string): ReactNode {
  if (value === null || value === undefined || value === "") return <span className="text-muted-foreground">—</span>
  if (typeof value === "boolean") return <Badge variant="outline">{value ? "Yes" : "No"}</Badge>
  if (Array.isArray(value)) return <Badge variant="secondary">{value.length} items</Badge>
  if (typeof value === "object") {
    const serialized = JSON.stringify(value)
    return <code className="block max-w-64 truncate text-xs text-muted-foreground" title={serialized}>{serialized}</code>
  }
  const text = String(value)
  if (/(?:^|_)(?:created|updated|start|end)?_?at$|(?:date|time)$/i.test(key)) {
    const date = new Date(text)
    if (!Number.isNaN(date.getTime())) return <time className="whitespace-nowrap tabular-nums" dateTime={date.toISOString()} title={text}>{dateFormatter.format(date)}</time>
  }
  if (/(?:^|_)(?:status|state|type|role)$/i.test(key)) return <Badge variant="secondary">{humanizeCellValue(text)}</Badge>
  if (/(?:url|link|website)$/i.test(key) && /^https?:\/\//i.test(text)) return <a className="block max-w-56 truncate text-primary underline-offset-4 hover:underline" href={text} rel="noreferrer" target="_blank" title={text}>Open link</a>
  if (typeof value === "number") return <span className="tabular-nums">{text}</span>
  return <span className="block max-w-72 truncate" title={text}>{text}</span>
}

export function AdminDataTable({ data, columns, loading, error, onRetry, mode = "client", searchable = false, rowCount, state, onStateChange, renderRowActions }: {
  data: unknown
  columns: readonly AdminColumnDefinition[]
  loading: boolean
  error: Error | null
  onRetry: () => void
  mode?: "client" | "server"
  searchable?: boolean
  rowCount?: number
  state?: AdminDataTableState
  onStateChange?: (state: AdminDataTableState) => void
  renderRowActions?: (row: Record<string, unknown>) => ReactNode
}) {
  const [localPagination, setLocalPagination] = useState<PaginationState>({ pageIndex: 0, pageSize: 20 })
  const [localSorting, setLocalSorting] = useState<SortingState>([])
  const [localFilters, setLocalFilters] = useState<ColumnFiltersState>([])
  const [localGlobalFilter, setLocalGlobalFilter] = useState("")
  const pagination = state?.pagination ?? localPagination
  const sorting = state?.sorting ?? localSorting
  const columnFilters = state?.columnFilters ?? localFilters
  const globalFilter = state?.globalFilter ?? localGlobalFilter
  const rows = Array.isArray(data) ? data as Array<Record<string, unknown>> : []
  const tableColumns = useMemo<ColumnDef<Record<string, unknown>>[]>(() => {
    const valueColumns: ColumnDef<Record<string, unknown>>[] = columns.map((column) => ({
      accessorKey: column.key,
      enableSorting: column.sortable ?? true,
      enableColumnFilter: column.filterable ?? Boolean(column.filter),
      header: ({ column: tableColumn }) => { if (!tableColumn.getCanSort()) return <span>{column.label}</span>; const direction = tableColumn.getIsSorted(); return <Button variant="ghost" className="-ml-3 gap-1.5" aria-label={`Sort by ${column.label}`} onClick={() => tableColumn.toggleSorting(direction === "asc")}>{column.label}{direction === "asc" ? <ArrowUp aria-hidden="true" className="size-3.5" /> : direction === "desc" ? <ArrowDown aria-hidden="true" className="size-3.5" /> : <ArrowUpDown aria-hidden="true" className="size-3.5 text-muted-foreground/70" />}</Button> },
      cell: ({ getValue, row }) => column.render ? column.render(getValue(), row.original) : formatAdminCell(getValue(), column.key),
    }))
    if (renderRowActions) valueColumns.push({ id: "actions", header: "Actions", enableSorting: false, enableColumnFilter: false, cell: ({ row }) => renderRowActions(row.original) })
    return valueColumns
  }, [columns, renderRowActions])
  const publish = (next: Partial<AdminDataTableState>) => onStateChange?.({ pagination, sorting, columnFilters, globalFilter, ...next })
  const table = useReactTable({
    data: rows,
    columns: tableColumns,
    state: { pagination, sorting, columnFilters, globalFilter },
    rowCount,
    manualPagination: mode === "server",
    manualSorting: mode === "server",
    manualFiltering: mode === "server",
    onPaginationChange: (updater) => { const next = typeof updater === "function" ? updater(pagination) : updater; setLocalPagination(next); publish({ pagination: next }) },
    onSortingChange: (updater) => { const next = typeof updater === "function" ? updater(sorting) : updater; setLocalSorting(next); publish({ sorting: next }) },
    onColumnFiltersChange: (updater) => { const next = typeof updater === "function" ? updater(columnFilters) : updater; setLocalFilters(next); publish({ columnFilters: next }) },
    onGlobalFilterChange: (updater) => { const next = typeof updater === "function" ? updater(globalFilter) : updater; setLocalGlobalFilter(String(next)); publish({ globalFilter: String(next), pagination: { ...pagination, pageIndex: 0 } }) },
    getCoreRowModel: getCoreRowModel(),
    getFilteredRowModel: getFilteredRowModel(),
    getSortedRowModel: getSortedRowModel(),
    getPaginationRowModel: getPaginationRowModel(),
  })
  const setFilterValue = (filter: AdminTableFilterDefinition, rawValue: string | null) => {
    const column = table.getColumn(filter.name)
    if (!column) return
    if (!rawValue || rawValue === "__all__") return column.setFilterValue(undefined)
    if (filter.type === "number") return column.setFilterValue(Number(rawValue))
    if (filter.type === "boolean") return column.setFilterValue(rawValue === "true")
    const option = filter.options?.find((value) => String(value) === rawValue)
    column.setFilterValue(option ?? rawValue)
  }
  if (loading) return <Card><CardHeader><Skeleton className="h-5 w-28" /><Skeleton className="h-4 w-52" /></CardHeader><CardContent className="space-y-3"><Skeleton className="h-9 w-full max-w-sm" /><Skeleton className="h-56 w-full" /></CardContent></Card>
  if (error) return <Alert variant="destructive"><AlertTitle>Unable to load data</AlertTitle><AlertDescription>{error.message}</AlertDescription><Button className="mt-3" variant="outline" onClick={onRetry}>Retry</Button></Alert>
  return <Card>
    <CardHeader className="border-b">
      <div><CardTitle>Records</CardTitle><CardDescription>Search, sort, and manage this resource.</CardDescription></div>
      {searchable || columns.some((column) => column.filter) ? <div className="mt-3 flex flex-wrap items-end gap-3">{searchable ? <div className="relative min-w-56 flex-1"><Search aria-hidden="true" className="pointer-events-none absolute left-3 top-1/2 size-4 -translate-y-1/2 text-muted-foreground" /><Input className="pl-9" aria-label="Search records" placeholder="Search records…" value={globalFilter} onChange={(event) => table.setGlobalFilter(event.target.value)} /></div> : null}{columns.flatMap((column) => column.filter ? [column.filter] : []).map((filter) => { const value = columnFilters.find(({ id }) => id === filter.name)?.value; return <div className="min-w-40 space-y-1" key={filter.name}><span className="text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground">{filter.name.replace(/[-_]+/g, " ")}</span>{filter.type === "select" || filter.type === "boolean" ? <Select value={value === undefined ? "__all__" : String(value)} onValueChange={(next) => setFilterValue(filter, next)}><SelectTrigger aria-label={`Filter by ${filter.name}`}><SelectValue placeholder="All" /></SelectTrigger><SelectContent><SelectItem value="__all__">All</SelectItem>{filter.type === "boolean" ? <><SelectItem value="true">Yes</SelectItem><SelectItem value="false">No</SelectItem></> : filter.options?.map((option) => <SelectItem key={String(option)} value={String(option)}>{String(option)}</SelectItem>)}</SelectContent></Select> : <Input aria-label={`Filter by ${filter.name}`} type={filter.type} value={value === undefined ? "" : String(value)} onChange={(event) => setFilterValue(filter, event.target.value)} />}</div> })}</div> : null}
    </CardHeader>
    <CardContent className="px-0">
      <div className="overflow-x-auto"><Table><TableHeader className="bg-muted/40">{table.getHeaderGroups().map((group) => <TableRow key={group.id}>{group.headers.map((header) => <TableHead key={header.id}>{header.isPlaceholder ? null : flexRender(header.column.columnDef.header, header.getContext())}</TableHead>)}</TableRow>)}</TableHeader><TableBody>{table.getRowModel().rows.length ? table.getRowModel().rows.map((row) => <TableRow className="hover:bg-muted/35" key={row.id}>{row.getVisibleCells().map((cell) => <TableCell className="max-w-80 break-words" key={cell.id}>{flexRender(cell.column.columnDef.cell, cell.getContext())}</TableCell>)}</TableRow>) : <TableRow><TableCell colSpan={tableColumns.length} className="h-56 text-center"><div className="mx-auto flex max-w-xs flex-col items-center gap-2 text-muted-foreground"><span className="flex size-10 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-muted"><Database aria-hidden="true" className="size-5" /></span><p className="font-medium text-foreground">No records found</p><p className="text-sm">Try adjusting your search or create the first record.</p></div></TableCell></TableRow>}</TableBody></Table></div>
    </CardContent>
    <CardFooter className="flex-col gap-3 border-t sm:flex-row sm:justify-between"><div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3 text-sm text-muted-foreground"><span className="tabular-nums">Page {pagination.pageIndex + 1} of {Math.max(table.getPageCount(), 1)}</span><span aria-hidden="true">·</span><span className="tabular-nums">{rowCount ?? rows.length} records</span><div className="flex items-center gap-2"><span>Rows per page</span><Select value={String(pagination.pageSize)} onValueChange={(value) => table.setPageSize(Number(value))}><SelectTrigger className="h-8 w-20" aria-label="Rows per page"><SelectValue /></SelectTrigger><SelectContent>{[20, 50, 100].map((size) => <SelectItem key={size} value={String(size)}>{size}</SelectItem>)}</SelectContent></Select></div></div><div className="flex items-center gap-2 self-end sm:self-auto"><Button variant="outline" size="sm" disabled={!table.getCanPreviousPage()} onClick={() => table.previousPage()}>Previous</Button><Button variant="outline" size="sm" disabled={!table.getCanNextPage()} onClick={() => table.nextPage()}>Next</Button></div></CardFooter>
  </Card>
}
